newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: New seismic oil hunt in Ivorian sedementary basin.
newsitem.headline: New seismic oil hunt in Ivorian sedementary basin.

text.p: Four foreign survey companies are to conduct a new seismic oil search in Ivory Coast's sedimentary basin with a view to selling details of any new finds to oil companies.

A government statement, published on Saturday, said that the cabinet had authorised state oil company PETROCI to sign contracts with the four companies for surveys in blocks CI-106, CI-110 and CI-111.
It identified the companies as GECO, PGS, Wavetech and Western Geophysical.
It said the four would fund the surveys and recoup their costs from sales of relevant data to interested oil companies.
The statement also authorised PETROCI to start negotiations with South Korean company Daewoo on selling it 10 percent of its production-sharing stake in the CI-11 bloc.
The money raised would be used to pay PETROCI debts to banks and help fund investment, it added.
